text:
Type: articulated pastel green work lamp
Use: task light for working or reading at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: retro, industrial, Scandinavian
Materials: glossy lacquered steel shade, arms and round base, exposed metal springs, black cord
Colors: soft pastel green, silver springs, black
Shape: rounded dome shade with a pull knob on a jointed spring-balanced arm, heavy round base, adjustable, compact
Feel: cheerful, playful, practical, fresh
Goes with: white or light wood desks, pastel tones, green plants; Scandinavian or retro home offices
